# HostifyOS Complete System Specification & Knowledge Graph

## 1. Executive Summary
HostifyOS (https://www.hostifyos.com) is the premier digital guest experience platform for short-term rental properties, luxury villas, and boutique hotels. It transforms static paper house manuals into interactive, mobile-optimized progressive web applications (PWAs) that require no app store downloads.

## 2. Platform Architecture
- **Front-End Architecture**: Vanilla modern JavaScript (ES6+), optimized DOM manipulation, CSS Variables, Plus Jakarta Sans & Outfit typography.
- **Hosting & CDN**: Edge-rendered on Vercel Global Edge Network with zero-latency global delivery.
- **Security & Headers**: Strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP), HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), X-Frame-Options (SAMEORIGIN), and subresource sanitization.
- **PWA Capabilities**: Service Worker caching, offline fallback mode, standalone fullscreen app manifest.

## 3. Core Features Taxonomy
### A. Check-in & Access Management
- 1-tap clipboard copying for Wi-Fi SSID and complex WPA2/WPA3 passwords.
- Time-gated electronic lockbox and smart door lock PIN codes (revealed 2 hours before arrival, terminated at 11:00 AM check-out).
- Video tutorials for tricky household appliances (induction cooktops, smart TVs, hot tubs, HVAC controls).

### B. Monetization & Revenue Expansion
- Built-in In-Room Concierge store allowing guests to order airport shuttles, late check-outs, luggage storage, breakfast baskets, and private tours.
- Multi-rail direct payment integration:
  - Credit / Debit Cards (Stripe / Dodo Payments merchant gateway)
  - 7/24 FAST & IBAN wire transfers
  - USDT Cryptocurrency wallets (TRC-20)
  - 1-tap direct WhatsApp host order dispatch
- 0% platform commission on Pro Host ($14/mo) and Enterprise tiers.

### C. Multi-Language Intelligence
- Native multi-language engine covering:
  - English (EN)
  - Turkish (TR)
  - Spanish (ES)
  - French (FR)
  - German (DE)
  - Italian (IT)
  - Portuguese (PT)
  - Arabic (AR) with full Bi-Directional Right-to-Left (RTL) rendering.

### D. AI Auto-Discovery & Regional Integration
- Real-time weather integration powered by Open-Meteo API.
- Live prayer times integration powered by Aladhan API.
- Live flight tracking and airport navigation.
- Dynamic regional emergency and taxi lookup with automatic 1-tap dial and Google Maps search.
